string-array.name: timer_finished_quotes
string-array.item: Yoga begins where the hurry ends.
Your body is not a burden you carry — it is the home you live in.
The breath is a bridge between body and mind. Cross it.
A flexible body starts with a flexible mind.
Practice is not perfection — it is keeping faith with yourself.
An hour on the mat comes back as a day of clarity.
It matters less how deep the pose is than how calm the breath stays.
Health is a daily habit, not a rare effort.
Every practice leaves a trace, even one you cannot see today.
Strength is born where you chose to stay for one more breath.
Stillness is not the absence of movement, but agreement with it.
You came to the mat — the hardest part is already behind you.
The quieter the practice, the deeper the change.
The body remembers care better than promises.
The best time to practise is the one that has already come.
Yoga is the stilling of the fluctuations of the mind.
Posture should be steady and comfortable.
Yoga is a light which, once lit, will never dim. The better your practice, the brighter the flame.
The body is my temple, asanas are my prayers.
Health is a state of complete harmony of the body, mind and spirit.
Practice, and all is coming.
Yoga is ninety-nine per cent practice and one per cent theory.
When the breath wanders, the mind is unsteady; when the breath is still, so is the mind.
You can\'t stop the waves, but you can learn to surf.
Strength does not come from physical capacity. It comes from an indomitable will.
All that we are is the result of what we have thought.
Yoga is not about touching your toes — it is about what you learn on the way down.
The success of yoga lies not in how you perform the postures, but in how it changes your life and your relationships.
The mat does not judge — it simply waits for you tomorrow.
Every exhale is a chance to let go of what you no longer carry.
The class is over — the practice goes on.
An hour of quiet is worth putting in the calendar.
Tomorrow the body remembers what you did for it today.
A calm breath outlasts any posture.
Coming back to the mat matters more than staying on it longer.

resources.string: ‹ swipe — stage · double tap — pause · tap or swipe up/down — exit ›
The countdown will stop and the session will not be resumed. The totals stay on screen.
Notifications are off: the session cannot be controlled from the shade, and the system is quicker to stop a service with no visible notification.
Total silence mutes the alarm channel — you will not hear the session cues.

While the app is alive the countdown runs on monotonic clocks and cues sound on time. But the system may evict it from memory, and getting back to the session can then take minutes. The unrestricted list removes that; vendor battery savers do not affect it.
Exact alarms are not allowed. The countdown is unaffected, but if the system evicts the app, the safety wake-up will be late.
